name: LIBERO-Constrained
scoring: spec.py evaluates each task's STL spec on the log; robustness in cm, degrees, cm/s
notes: Every rule is an STL formula over logged motion. Spatial tasks add one real object to a stock LIBERO scene (obstacles/build.py; nothing already there is moved); the other families use LIBERO's own scenes and start states. Limits are set so that unconstrained motion breaks them and careful motion can meet them.
